ANIMA ComfyUI 工作流程 + KJNodes 分辨率预设

这是用于 ANIMA / WAI-ANIMA 风格图像生成的 ComfyUI 工作流程。

它包括：

  • 分割提示输入：基地, 添加01, 添加02, 添加03

  • 动态提示支持

  • 及时删除评论

  • 最终提示预览

  • 可选 LoRA 加载器

  • 碱基生成阶段

  • 可选的 Ultimate SD 高档阶段

  • 自定义 KJNodes 分辨率预设

请从这篇文章下载这两个文件：

Stick_anima_workflow.json
自定义尺寸.json

Stick_anima_workflow.json是 ComfyUI 工作流程。
自定义尺寸.json是 KJNodes 的自定义分辨率预设文件。

安装

1.加载工作流程

拖放Stick_anima_workflow.json进入 ComfyUI。

如果出现缺少节点，请安装下面列出的所需自定义节点。

2.安装KJNodes预设文件

地点自定义尺寸.json直接在 KJNodes 文件夹中：

ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-KJNodes/custom_dimensions.json

请勿将其放入型号/, 输入/, 输出/，或 KJNodes 内的子文件夹。

正确：

ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-KJNodes/custom_dimensions.json

错误：

ComfyUI/models/custom_dimensions.json
ComfyUI/input/custom_dimensions.json
ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-KJNodes/nodes/custom_dimensions.json

复制文件后，重新启动 ComfyUI。

如果空潜在图像自定义预设不显示自定义分辨率列表，请检查：

1. 文件名正是custom_dimensions.json
2.该文件直接位于ComfyUI-KJNodes内部
3.复制文件后ComfyUI重新启动
4.KJNodes安装正确

所需型号

文本编码器

  • qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors

将其放置在这里：

ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors

vae

  • qwen_image_vae.safetensors

将其放置在这里：

ComfyUI/models/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors

diffusion_models

此工作流程配置为：

  • waiANIMA_v10.safetensors / WAI-ANIMA v1.0

将其放置在这里：

ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/waiANIMA_v10.safetensors

如果您的 ComfyUI 使用模型/unet/而不是模型/diffusion_models/，将模型放置在那里或在UNET加载器节点。

替代基本模型：

  • anima-base-v1.0.safetensors

如果您使用此模型，请在UNET加载器节点。

高档模型

此工作流程使用以下 2x 高档模型：

  • up2x-最新-denoise3x.pth

将其放置在这里：

ComfyUI/models/upscale_models/weights_v3/up2x-latest-denoise3x.pth

如果升频器存储在其他地方，请在高档模型加载器节点。

可选LoRA

该工作流程包括此 LoRA动力劳拉装载机 (rg Three)，但默认情况下它是关闭的：

  • anima-rl-v0.1.safetensors / Anima RL

将其放置在这里：

ComfyUI/models/loras/Anima/anima-rl-v0.1.safetensors

手动启用它动力劳拉装载机 (rg Three)如果你想使用它。

│ ├── 文本编码器/

│ │

│ │ └── waiANIMA_v10.safetensors
│ │
│ │ # 可选替代方案：
│ │ # anima-base-v1.0.safetensors
│ │
│ ├── 高档模型/
│ │ └──weights_v3/
│ │ └── up2x-latest-denoise3x.pth
│ │
│ └── 洛拉斯/
│ └── 加油/
│ └── anima-rl-v0.1.safetensors

所需的自定义节点

安装以下自定义节点。

舒适UI管理器

  • 舒适UI管理器

建议用于安装缺失的节点。

rg三舒适

  • rg三舒适

使用的节点：

动力劳拉装载机 (rg Three)
种子 (rg三)
快速组旁路器 (rg Three)
图像比较器 (rg Three)

KJ节点

  • ComfyUI-KJNodes

使用的节点：

空潜在图像自定义预设
连接字符串多

还放置包含的自定义尺寸.json直接在里面：

ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-KJNodes/

ComfyUI 的效率节点

  • 效率节点-comfyui

使用的节点：

KSampler（高效）

终极标清高档

  • ComfyUI_UltimateSDUpscale

使用的节点：

终极SD高档

动态提示

  • 舒适的动态提示

使用的节点：

DPR随机发生器

ComfyUI Lora 经理

  • ComfyUI-Lora-Manager

使用的节点：

保存图像（LoraManager）

ComfyUI 易于使用

  • ComfyUI-易于使用

使用的节点：

轻松展示一切

ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-KJNodes/custom_dimensions.json

然后重新启动ComfyUI。

ComfyUI 易于使用

如果工作流程加载时出现红色缺失节点框，请打开 ComfyUI Manager 并使用：

安装缺少的自定义节点

然后重新启动ComfyUI。

KJNodes安装完成后，复制自定义尺寸.json进入：

ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-KJNodes/

然后再次重新启动 ComfyUI。

如何使用

  1. 下载Stick_anima_workflow.json和自定义尺寸.json.

  2. 拖放Stick_anima_workflow.json进入 ComfyUI。

  3. 如果需要，安装缺少的自定义节点。

  4. 下载所需的模型文件。

  5. 将模型放置在正确的文件夹中。

  6. 地点自定义尺寸.json直接在里面ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-KJNodes/.

  7. 重新启动 ComfyUI。

  8. 检查负载模型分组并确保正确选择模型、文本编码器、VAE 和升级器。

  9. 选择分辨率空潜在图像自定义预设.

  10. 将您的提示写在基地, 添加01, 添加02, 和添加03.

  11. 将不需要的元素写入阴性.

  12. 对工作流程进行排队。

提示系统

正面提示分为：

基地
添加01
添加02
添加03

它们在生成之前自动连接。

工作流程支持删除评论。

单行注释：

// 该行将被忽略

区块评论：

/*
该块将被忽略
*/

最终处理的提示显示在轻松展示一切节点。

动态提示语法

此工作流程支持动态提示语法。

示例：

{短发|长发|波浪发}，{蓝眼睛|红眼睛|绿眼睛}

在生成过程中将随机选择一个选项。

分辨率预设

所包含的自定义尺寸.json添加多个分辨率预设空潜在图像自定义预设.

它包括方形、横向、宽幅、横幅和平铺尺寸预设。

一些条目被标记为[平铺]。这些适用于平铺工作流程或高 VRAM 环境。如果出现内存不足错误，请使用较小的预设。

高档纸币

此工作流程包括 Ultimate SD Upscale 阶段。

默认的高档型号是：

up2x-最新-denoise3x.pth

预期路径：

ComfyUI/models/upscale_models/weights_v3/up2x-latest-denoise3x.pth

如果升频器丢失或存储在其他文件夹中，请在高档模型加载器节点。

高档阶段可能比基础一代阶段需要更多的 VRAM。如果出现内存不足错误，请绕过高档组或降低基本分辨率。

推荐首次运行

对于第一个测试，仅运行基础生成阶段。

确认工作流程有效后，启用高档阶段。

当前工作流程设置：

基本采样器：er_sde
基本调度程序：简单
基本步数：36
CFG底座：4
基础降噪：1.0
高档采样器：er_sde
高档调度程序：测试版
高档台阶：30
高档 CFG：3
高档降噪：0.3

ANIMA ComfyUI Workflow + KJNodes Resolution Presets

This is a ComfyUI workflow for ANIMA / WAI-ANIMA style image generation.

It includes:

  • Split prompt input:BASE, ADD 01, ADD 02, ADD 03

  • Dynamic Prompts support

  • Prompt comment removal

  • Final prompt preview

  • Optional LoRA loader

  • Base generation stage

  • Optional Ultimate SD Upscale stages

  • Custom KJNodes resolution presets

Please download both files from this post:

stick_anima_workflow.json
custom_dimensions.json

stick_anima_workflow.jsonis the ComfyUI workflow.
custom_dimensions.jsonis the custom resolution preset file for KJNodes.

Installation

1. Load the workflow

Drag and dropstick_anima_workflow.jsoninto ComfyUI.

If missing nodes appear, install the required custom nodes listed below.

2. Install KJNodes preset file

Placecustom_dimensions.jsondirectly inside the KJNodes folder:

ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-KJNodes/custom_dimensions.json

Do not place it inmodels/, input/, output/, or a subfolder inside KJNodes.

Correct:

ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-KJNodes/custom_dimensions.json

Incorrect:

ComfyUI/models/custom_dimensions.json
ComfyUI/input/custom_dimensions.json
ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-KJNodes/nodes/custom_dimensions.json

After copying the file, restart ComfyUI.

IfEmptyLatentImageCustomPresetsdoes not show the custom resolution list, check that:

1. The file name is exactly custom_dimensions.json
2. The file is directly inside ComfyUI-KJNodes
3. ComfyUI was restarted after copying the file
4. KJNodes is installed correctly

Required Models

text_encoders

  • qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors

Place it here:

ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors

vae

  • qwen_image_vae.safetensors

Place it here:

ComfyUI/models/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors

diffusion_models

This workflow is configured for:

  • waiANIMA_v10.safetensors / WAI-ANIMA v1.0

Place it here:

ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/waiANIMA_v10.safetensors

If your ComfyUI usesmodels/unet/instead ofmodels/diffusion_models/, place the model there or manually reselect it in theUNETLoadernode.

Alternative base model:

  • anima-base-v1.0.safetensors

If you use this model, manually select it in theUNETLoadernode.

upscale_models

This workflow uses the following 2x upscale model:

  • up2x-latest-denoise3x.pth

Place it here:

ComfyUI/models/upscale_models/weights_v3/up2x-latest-denoise3x.pth

If the upscaler is stored somewhere else, manually reselect it in theUpscaleModelLoadernode.

Optional LoRA

The workflow includes this LoRA inPower Lora Loader (rgthree), but it is turned OFF by default:

  • anima-rl-v0.1.safetensors / Anima RL

Place it here:

ComfyUI/models/loras/Anima/anima-rl-v0.1.safetensors

Enable it manually inPower Lora Loader (rgthree)if you want to use it.

│ │

│ └── anima-rl-v0.1.safetensors

Install the following custom nodes.

ComfyUI Manager

Recommended for installing missing nodes.

rgthree-comfy

  • rgthree-comfy

Seed (rgthree)

Image Comparer (rgthree)

KJNodes

  • ComfyUI-KJNodes

Used nodes:

EmptyLatentImageCustomPresets
JoinStringMulti

Also place the includedcustom_dimensions.jsondirectly inside:

ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-KJNodes/

Efficiency Nodes for ComfyUI

  • efficiency-nodes-comfyui

Used node:

KSampler (Efficient)

Ultimate SD Upscale

  • ComfyUI_UltimateSDUpscale

Used node:

UltimateSDUpscale

Used node:

DPRandomGenerator

ComfyUI Lora Manager

  • ComfyUI-Lora-Manager

Used node:

Save Image (LoraManager)

ComfyUI Easy Use

Used node:

easy showAnything

└── custom_nodes/

Git Install Commands

Open a terminal in:

ComfyUI/custom_nodes/

Then run:

git clone https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy
git clone https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes
git clone https://github.com/jags111/efficiency-nodes-comfyui
git clone https://github.com/ssitu/ComfyUI_UltimateSDUpscale --recursive
git clone https://github.com/adieyal/comfyui-dynamicprompts
git clone https://github.com/willmiao/ComfyUI-Lora-Manager
git clone https://github.com/yolain/ComfyUI-Easy-Use

After installing custom nodes, placecustom_dimensions.jsonhere:

ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-KJNodes/custom_dimensions.json

Then restart ComfyUI.

ComfyUI Manager Search Keywords

You can also install the required custom nodes from ComfyUI Manager.

Search keywords:

rgthree
KJNodes
efficiency-nodes-comfyui
UltimateSDUpscale
dynamicprompts
lora-manager
ComfyUI Easy Use

If the workflow loads with red missing-node boxes, open ComfyUI Manager and use:

Install Missing Custom Nodes

Then restart ComfyUI.

After KJNodes is installed, copycustom_dimensions.jsoninto:

ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-KJNodes/

Then restart ComfyUI again.

How to Use

  1. Downloadstick_anima_workflow.jsonandcustom_dimensions.json.

  2. Drag and dropstick_anima_workflow.jsoninto ComfyUI.

  3. Install missing custom nodes if needed.

  4. Download the required model files.

  5. Place the models in the correct folders.

  6. Placecustom_dimensions.jsondirectly insideComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-KJNodes/.

  7. Restart ComfyUI.

  8. Check theload modelgroup and make sure the model, text encoder, VAE, and upscaler are selected correctly.

  9. Select a resolution inEmptyLatentImageCustomPresets.

  10. Write your prompt inBASE, ADD 01, ADD 02, andADD 03.

  11. Write unwanted elements inNegative.

  12. Queue the workflow.

Prompt System

The positive prompt is split into:

BASE
ADD 01
ADD 02
ADD 03

They are joined automatically before generation.

The workflow supports comment removal.

Single-line comment:

// this line will be ignored

Block comment:

/*
this block will be ignored
*/

The final processed prompt is displayed in theeasy showAnythingnode.

Dynamic Prompt Syntax

This workflow supports Dynamic Prompts syntax.

Example:

{short hair|long hair|wavy hair}, {blue eyes|red eyes|green eyes}

One option will be randomly selected during generation.

Resolution Presets

The includedcustom_dimensions.jsonadds multiple resolution presets toEmptyLatentImageCustomPresets.

It includes square, landscape, wide, banner, and tiled-size presets.

Some entries are marked as[Tiled]. These are intended for tiled workflows or high-VRAM environments. If you get out-of-memory errors, use a smaller preset.

Upscale Notes

This workflow includes Ultimate SD Upscale stages.

The default upscale model is:

up2x-latest-denoise3x.pth

Expected path:

ComfyUI/models/upscale_models/weights_v3/up2x-latest-denoise3x.pth

If the upscaler is missing or stored in another folder, select it manually in theUpscaleModelLoadernode.

The upscale stage may require more VRAM than the base generation stage. If you get out-of-memory errors, bypass the upscale groups or lower the base resolution.

Recommended First Run

For the first test, run only the base generation stage.

After confirming that the workflow works, enable the upscale stage.

Current workflow settings:

Base sampler: er_sde
Base scheduler: simple
Base steps: 36
Base CFG: 4
Base denoise: 1.0
Upscale sampler: er_sde
Upscale scheduler: beta
Upscale steps: 30
Upscale CFG: 3
Upscale denoise: 0.3

Notes

This upload contains:

Workflow JSON
KJNodes custom resolution preset JSON

The following files are not included:

Base model
Text encoder
VAE
Upscale model
LoRA
Custom nodes

Please download them separately from the links above.

Follow the license and usage terms of each model, LoRA, and custom node.
